messages.subject: Model for a network of a wastewater system
parts:
Dear All,


Now I am analyzing the data collected from a wastewater system that looks like a tree-graph with so many branches. At each branch, one measurement of a dominant gas is collected at a particular time.

Could you please recommend me one specific model that you think can describe approximately this system?

Any suggestion would be very appreciated.

Thank you so much in advance!

Regards,
